title: Analysis code and aggregate results: physical activity types, barriers and eating patterns among junior high school students in urban, suburban and rural Badung, Bali (2025 school survey)
description: Cleaning, analysis, school-clustering sensitivity and de-identification code, with aggregate result tables and figures, for a cross-sectional survey of 1,898 students in grades 7–9 at five public junior high schools in Badung Regency, Bali, Indonesia (17 September – 2 October 2025). No student-level data are included; the de-identified student-level dataset is in Mendeley Data (doi:10.17632/f2mvjrf32w.1). Code: MIT licence; aggregate results and documents: CC BY 4.0.
